# lighting-material-plan (reference summary)

## Purpose
Build detailed lighting and material direction with portability and caveat handling for Blender/web-3D outputs.

Create a high-quality, practical lighting/material plan that balances visual intent and web portability constraints.

## Metadata & truth boundary
- **Canonical skill:** `skills/lighting-material-plan/SKILL.md`
- **Contract:** `skills/lighting-material-plan/contract.json` (`v1.0.0`)
- **Category / role:** `scene-planners` / `lighting-rig-and-lookdev-deep-planner`
- **Capability tier:** `L0`
- **Truth-state policy:** Runtime status defaults to `Not Run`; Artifact status defaults to `Not Produced`; mutation rule is `downgrade_only` (never upgrade without verified evidence).

## When to use
- look-development strategy is needed
- lighting/material choices drive scene mood
- web/GLB portability caveats must be explicit

## Trigger cues
- "plan lighting and materials"
- "design cyberpunk lookdev"
- "define PBR and reflection strategy"

## When not to use
- to claim final rendered quality or executed results → delegate to `camera-composition` (`references/skills/camera-composition.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to camera-composition)
- to skip composition/camera context from camera-composition → delegate to `camera-composition` (`references/skills/camera-composition.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to camera-composition)
- to validate existing lighting or materials → delegate to `lighting-quality-checker` (`references/skills/lighting-quality-checker.md`; use lighting-quality-checker and material-quality-checker)
- to decide render engines (cycles-vs-eevee-decision), color management (color-management-decision), or file formats (output-format-decision) → delegate to `color-management-decision` (`references/skills/color-management-decision.md`; output-format-decision)
- to execute Blender or generate Python scripts → delegate to `color-management-decision` (`references/skills/color-management-decision.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to color-management-decision)

## Inputs & output/evidence contract
### Required inputs
- `domain_scene_plan` (`object`): Upstream scene layout and subject surface description
- `camera_framing_plan` (`object`): Locked camera angles and hero silhouette requirements from camera-composition

### Optional inputs
- `target_render_engine_hint` (`string`): Preferred engine (Cycles, Eevee, or WebGL/GLB PBR export target)

### Primary outputs
- `key_fill_rim_lighting_plan`
- `pbr_material_and_roughness_spec`
- `hdri_and_reflection_strategy`

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- **Runtime boundary:** This is a planning-only skill: no Blender execution, no Python, and no artifact generation. Runtime status always remains `Not Run` and artifact status always remains `Not Produced` (truth states are downgrade-only, never upgrade). If referencing Eevee engine tokens from upstream `cycles-vs-eevee-decision`, use `BLENDER_EEVEE` on Blender 4.0–4.1 and 5.x, and `BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT` only for 4.2–4.x — never present Eevee Next as the current name.
- shader/runtime implementation code
- rendered quality claims without evidence
